CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2524 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head e62be31de2c3d80217d6d855b59f7d27f5392826. Bus nonce: 2323f58f7847338368024f6c55dff26b. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin e62be31de2c3d80217d6d855b59f7d27f5392826`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge e62be31de2c3d80217d6d855b59f7d27f5392826` or `Fix review: blocked e62be31de2c3d80217d6d855b59f7d27f5392826 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 2323f58f7847338368024f6c55dff26b`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `e62be31de2c3d80217d6d855b59f7d27f5392826` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2524 e62be31de2c3d80217d6d855b59f7d27f5392826") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2524-2323f58f`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
RE-REVIEW, ADVERSARIAL, of PR #2524 (R10-UPDATE-PR-SIGNALS, branch fix/r10-pusher-reap) at head e62be31de2c3d80217d6d855b59f7d27f5392826. Past round 3: the body was re-cut minimal. Last verdict BLOCKED at a0162771 (`git fetch origin review/2524 && git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md`); the fixer answered it in eight commits (12:03Z), then merged main resolving a conflict in tools/audit/seat/merge_train.py against #2584's CI-state classifier (fixer tip 2d5d6be11). PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. Spare the GitHub API.
Check: 1. Each item of the a0162771 block is answered at this head, with the failing-test-first and mutation evidence fixer.md asks for; apply the body's mutants yourself. 2. merge_train.py: #2584's classifier stays the only definition of CI state, and this PR's process-stop fix sits on top of it; no duplicated logic; #2584's own tests still pass. 3. The SIGKILL residual and self-test isolation are carried to R10-UPDATE-PR-SIGNALS (group stays in-progress) — confirm the carry is honest, not a hidden defect this PR claims to fix. 4. Figures re-derive; Red checks names every red; merge-tree clean; carry_audit 0 unrouted 0 bad.
Return merge unless a required item fails. Time box 60 min.
